scope: Independent falsification of weak-signal detector on archived background plus hidden injected tracks, not evidence for sky origin.

custodian.required: Independent operator with no participation in candidate development; controls selection, hidden labels and injection seed, signs result. Internal agents and GitHub CI cannot satisfy independence.
before_test: Freeze code commit, dependencies, model weights and complete thresholds; freeze source exclusion list including all development and R21BC targets.
Generate secret 256-bit seed and salt; publish SHA256 commitment and signed split manifest containing target IDs or hidden manifest commitment before opening candidate output.

Select at least 12 disjoint telescope pointings with at least two same-pointing scans, spanning receiver/day domains. Include candidate-independent selection criterion and publish acquisition failure accounting.

Create paired background/injected observations without exposing labels, injection positions, amplitude, morphology, or source-label side channels; shuffle IDs independently. Keep a separate calibration cohort unavailable to test.

controls.primary: Unmodified real-spectrum paired controls only for calibration/primary false alert rate; challenge false alerts separately, not pooled.
controls.source_identity: Do not count multiple slices from same observation as independent units.

evaluation.primary: Paired localized recovery at 0.75–1.25 robust local noise scales; localization at least 75% of injected active samples within two bins; also report raw alerts, 1.5/2-scale, per morphology and missing scan, all UNKNOWN and failures.
comparators: frozen R21BC timestamp joint if it passes
frozen R21E model and logistic if eligible
evaluation.calibration: Equal predeclared 5% control alert target on separate calibration data, no test threshold fitting. Do not claim equal sensitivity if realized control rates differ.
evaluation.statistical_gate: Predeclare target-cluster bootstrap 95% intervals from 12 or more independent pointings, paired localized recall difference versus frozen joint baseline; success requires lower bound >0 and control alert increase upper bound <=0.02 absolute. Report each receiver/day stratum and abstention. If underpowered, HOLD, not PASS.
evaluation.cost: Report cold I/O, warm cache, calibration, full feature extraction, training, inference, memory, and proof/witness replay separately. Do not multiply stage accelerations.
evaluation.disclosure: Reveal seed, labels and signed manifests only after submitted candidate output digest. Independent reproduce score, validate no label leakage, publish failures.
